# ELSE

Start the branch of a DO IF block for the cases no condition matched.

## Syntax

```text
ELSE.
```

Inside a DO IF block, after the ELSE IF branches: the commands that follow run for the cases no condition of the block matched. A case with a missing condition does not reach it.

## Example

```text
ELSE.
```

`statscraft help ELSE` prints the same text in the terminal. [All commands](README.md)
